announcements.text: Akima Intra-Data LLC, Herndon, Virginia (FA300226D0005); Choctaw Defense Services Inc., Durant, Oklahoma (FA300226D0006); Chugach Intelligence Solutions LLC, Anchorage, Alaska (FA300226D0007); KTH Services JV LLC, Herndon, Virgina (FA300226D0008); Tunista Logistics Solutions LLC, Huntsville, Alabama (FA300226D0009); ASRC Federal Gulf State Constructors LLC, Reston, Virginia (FA300226D0010); ASRC Federal Infrastructure Support LLC, Reston, Virginia (FA300226D0011); Akima Global Logistics LLC, Herndon, Virginia (FA300226D0012); Alutiiq Operations Services LLC, Anchorage, Alaska (FA300226D0013); North Wind Dynamics LLC, Idaho Falls, Idaho (FA300226D0014); ASRC Federal Case Processing LLC, Reston, Virginia (FA300226D0015); Alcyon Inc., Anchorage, Alaska (FA300226D0016); Bering Straits Management Services LLC, Anchorage, Alaska (FA300226D0017); CBG-PSS JV LLC, Parkland, Florida (FA300226D0018); NFG LLC, Rockville, Maryland (FA300226D0019); Fortis Native Group LLC, Atmore, Alabama (FA300226D0021); K&N Solutions LLC, Baldwin, Louisiana (FA300226D0022); Kira Facilities Maintenance LLC, Lynnwood, Washington (FA300226D0023); and Stratobase LLC, Fulton, Maryland (FA300226D002), were awarded a ceiling $4,000,000,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award contract for Air Education Training Command base operations support. This contract provides for base operations support in the following service areas: transient aircraft maintenance, resource management, communications and information technology, visual information services, publishing management, installation management, operations and management, installation engineering, grounds maintenance, emergency management, vertical transportation equipment, fire and emergency services, airfield management, supply and logistics material management services, transportation, purchasing, community services, human resources, weather, and custodial services. Work will be performed at Vance Air Force Base, Enid Oklahoma; Sheppard AFB, Wichita Falls, Texas; Maxwell AFB, Montgomery Alabama; Laughlin AFB, Del Rio Texas; Keesler AFB, Biloxi Mississippi; Luke AFB, Glendale Arizona; Holloman AFB, Alamogordo New Mexico; Goodfellow AFB, San Angelo Texas; Columbus AFB, Columbus Mississippi; Altus AFB, Altus Oklahoma; and Joint Base San Antonio, Texas; and is expected to be completed by June 30, 2036. These contracts were competitive acquisitions and 22 offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $47,500 are being obligated at the time of award. The 338th Enterprise Sourcing Squadron, Joint Base San Antonio-Randolph AFB, Texas, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Woodward Inc., Fort Collins, Colorado, is awarded a $51,678,766 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity supply contract for the procurement of next generation ship service gas turbine generator full authority digital control cabinets. A maximum quantity of 123 will be provided over the life of the contract. Work will be performed in Fort Collins, Colorado, and is expected to be completed by January 2031. Fiscal 2026 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,536,056 will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured in accordance with 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1)-only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity (N64498-26-D-1012).

announcements.text: Defense Martine Solutions Inc., Chesapeake, Virginia, is awarded a $12,477,576 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for various engineering services to include on-site repairs of Navy submarine propellers and propulsors. Work will be performed in Portsmouth, New Hampshire (15%); Norfolk, Virginia (15%); Cheatham, Virginia (15%); Bangor, Washington (15%); Barstow, California (15%); Santa Rita, Guam (15%); and San Diego, California (10%), and is expected to be completed by June 2031. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $500 will be obligated at time of award and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured via System for Award Management website, with one offer received. The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity (N64498-26-D-1007).
